preexisting_x5_witness.defect: The X5 preregistration copied the local x86-64/Windows action witness into an aarch64 screen even though the existing reviewed X5 result already proved the architecture-specific witness.

launch_precondition_failure.launcher_error: The shell redirection to scaling_governor occurred outside the effective sudo context and was denied before each intended write.
launch_precondition_failure.runner_defect: The runner recorded the failed governor check after both arms instead of aborting before the first measured tick, allowing an inadmissible timing population to be collected.

admissible_semantic_evidence.interpretation: The architecture-specific numeric witness differs from the local witness, but original T247 and specialized T247 remain exactly equal to each other on the X5. The specialization semantic mechanism passed.

inadmissible_timing_evidence.reason: The frozen screen requires the performance governor. The schedutil distribution cannot accept or reject the context-route specialization.

validity_decision.rationale: This is the same evidence discipline previously used for invalid unaggregated policy outputs: an execution that violates a mandatory precondition and an already-contradicted witness is not treated as a valid gate attempt. The old contract is not rerun; a corrected contract must be frozen before any replacement execution.

pin or compare the aarch64 calibration context 69a92214... and retain lower-cond0 selection
make the runner abort before graph initialization or any arm unless governor is performance
use a launch wrapper whose privileged governor write is verified before starting the runner
